verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms issue creation (IssueCreate mutation) and assignment (assignedIssues, agents 'delegated issues through assignment') as core API/product capabilities, implying basic task creation and assignment support, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents setting or displaying due dates on issues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a due-date field on issues, UI walkthrough of assigning a task with a due date, and independent confirmation of this specific workflow.
